name: io.github.ljcl/gaggiuino-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for your Gaggiuino espresso machine's shots and profiles

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public https origin clients reach this server on, with no path (e.g. https://box.tailnet.ts.net). Set with MCP_OAUTH_SECRET to enable OAuth; it is advertised as the OAuth resource and must match the URL entered in the client exactly

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signing key for self-issued OAuth access and refresh tokens, at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Keep it stable across restarts so clients stay signed in

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PASSPHRASE_HASH
environmentVariables.description: scrypt hash of the passphrase you type on the OAuth consent page, in the form scrypt$N$r$p$salt$hash. Required whenever OAuth is enabled. Generate with `bun run hash-passphrase` — never store the passphrase itself

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call /mcp, or * to allow any (unsafe). Requests with no Origin header are unaffected

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept on /mcp. Empty disables host validation
